item.name: Attack Orb
item.effect: Increases weapon and gun damage by 8%.
item.cardSummary: A simple damage slot when you want more gun pressure without a timed proc.

item.name: Combat Helmet
item.effect: Increases maximum health by 15%.
item.cardSummary: Raises your health ceiling. Pair it with healing when burst damage is ending runs.

item.name: Energy Drink
item.effect: Increases movement speed and fire rate by 10%.
item.cardSummary: A tempo slot for moving between lanes and shooting faster.

item.name: Kevlar Plate
item.effect: Reduces damage taken from zombies by 10%.
item.cardSummary: Cuts incoming zombie damage instead of adding extra health.

item.name: Lucky Coin
item.effect: Gives a 20% chance to earn event currency twice from a drop.
item.cardSummary: Use it when an event currency is the goal. It does not replace Credit farming Artifacts.

item.name: Recycler
item.effect: Gives a 20% chance to earn extra Credits after each zombie kill.
item.cardSummary: A kill-linked Credit slot for long waves while expensive unlocks are still unpaid.

item.name: Sword
item.effect: Summons a hovering sword that deals 30 damage to nearby zombies every 4 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Adds hands-free nearby damage. Fixed damage loses value as zombie health climbs.

item.name: Thorns
item.effect: Zombies that hit you take 150% of the damage they deal.
item.cardSummary: A retaliation option that should punish zombies for hitting you. Confirm the reflect still works on your patch.

item.name: Adrenaline Surge
item.effect: Each kill has a 5% chance to increase movement speed by 15% for a short time.
item.cardSummary: A proc-based speed bump after kills. Exact duration is not published in current lists.

item.name: Blood Vial
item.effect: Restores 5 health after every 5 zombie kills.
item.cardSummary: Slow self-heal that needs a steady kill streak. Weak against burst damage that lands between procs.

item.name: Cryo Fuel
item.effect: Guns have a 10% chance to slow zombies by 35%.
item.cardSummary: Adds occasional slow to gun hits. Useful when you already have a reliable lane weapon.

item.name: Dynamite
item.effect: Each kill has a 5% chance to explode, dealing 25% of that zombie's maximum health to nearby enemies.
item.cardSummary: A packed-wave proc. It needs kills in a cluster before the explosion pays off.

item.name: Iron Dagger
item.effect: Throws a dagger at the nearest zombie every 4 seconds, dealing 10 damage.
item.cardSummary: A single-target auto throw on a timer. Later-wave health makes the 10 damage a small chip.

item.name: Red Toolbox
item.effect: Restores 25% health to deployed gear and increases that gear's health and damage by 25%.
item.cardSummary: The structure-build slot. It only matters if your class actually places turrets, barricades, or similar gear.

item.name: Repulsor Orb
item.effect: Knocks melee zombies away when they attack you.
item.cardSummary: Pushes melee attackers off you when they connect. Exact range and cooldown are unpublished.

item.name: Boomerang
item.effect: Throws a boomerang every 6 seconds that pierces zombies and hits them twice for 40 damage each time.
item.cardSummary: A repeating pierce throw through a lane. Best when zombies line up in the return path.

item.name: Ember Orb
item.effect: Ignites nearby zombies every 6 seconds, dealing 16 damage per second for 6 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A repeating nearby burn. Also listed as Amber Orb in some guides.

item.name: Frost Orb
item.effect: Releases a frost pulse every 6 seconds that slows nearby zombies by 40%.
item.cardSummary: Timed area slow around you. Pair it with lane damage rather than treating it as a kill tool.

item.name: Healing Orb
item.effect: Heals you and nearby allies for 10 health every 8 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A pulse heal that also covers teammates in range. More useful in grouped holds than isolated solo play.

item.name: Hunter's Mark
item.effect: Exposes the toughest nearby zombies so they take 25% more damage from everyone.
item.cardSummary: Makes the toughest nearby zombies take 25% more damage from everyone. Target count and timers are unpublished.

item.name: Midas Touch
item.effect: Gives a 15% chance for defeated zombies to drop double minerals.
item.cardSummary: An extra-drop slot for minerals, not Credits. Confirm the live currency label before using it as a farm plan.

item.name: Special Drone
item.effect: Summons a drone that shoots nearby zombies for 15 damage per shot.
item.cardSummary: Hands-free gun damage while you aim elsewhere. Separate from the class gear Drone.

item.name: Bank
item.effect: Stores 10% of Credits earned during the run and pays them out when the run ends. Leaving early forfeits the stored Credits.
item.cardSummary: A finish-the-run Credit bonus. Skip it if you expect to disconnect, crash, or quit mid-wave.

item.name: Cursed Doll
item.effect: Increases gun damage by 25% and reduces maximum health by 20%. Zombies that hit you become cursed and lose 4% of their maximum health every second.
item.cardSummary: A damage-for-health trade plus a curse on attackers. Test it on a class that can survive the health cut.

item.name: Electric Pillar
item.effect: Reported to strike a nearby zombie cluster with lightning.
item.cardSummary: Still named in Epic crate tables, but current guides mark it unobtainable. Exact damage and timer are unverified.

item.name: Gravity Core
item.effect: Creates a small singularity every 10 seconds that pulls nearby zombies together.
item.cardSummary: Groups a pack for area damage. It does not replace a damage Artifact on its own.

item.name: Phoenix Feather
item.effect: Erupts in flames every 20 seconds. A killing blow revives the holder once every 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: A timed flame burst plus a revive after a killing blow, once every 10 minutes. Flame damage and revive health are unpublished.

item.name: Warding Totem
item.effect: Grants a shield every 15 seconds that absorbs damage equal to 20% of maximum health. When the shield breaks, it reflects the absorbed damage to nearby zombies.
item.cardSummary: A timed shield that can dump stored hits back into a pack. Prevention, not a replacement for healing.

item.name: Chrono Core
item.effect: Traps the nearest zombies in a stasis field for 4 seconds every 12 seconds.
item.cardSummary: A timed hold on the nearest cluster so the lane can be cleared. Also styled Chronocore in some lists.

item.name: Deathbloom
item.effect: Each kill has a 5% chance to create a poison flower. Nearby zombies take 6.5% of their maximum health per second, move more slowly, and keep taking poison for 3 seconds after leaving the cloud. When the flower fades, it releases healing pollen.
item.cardSummary: A kill-proc flower that slows, percent-burns, and can heal when it ends. Needs a kill to start.

item.name: Gaming Controller
item.effect: Increases damage by 15%, health by 10%, movement speed by 10%, and critical hit chance by 10%.
item.cardSummary: The broad stat package covering damage, health, movement, and crit. A default Legendary keep for gun runs.

item.name: Venus Snaptrap
item.effect: Clamps the toughest nearby zombie every 10 seconds for 4 seconds, dealing 5% of that zombie's maximum health per second. The trap takes 25% damage and restores 4 health or 1% of your maximum health per bite.
item.cardSummary: A repeating clamp on a high-health target that also feeds a small heal.

item.name: Soulforge Lantern
item.effect: Each kill grants a soul that increases gun damage by 0.3%, up to 15%. After 50 souls, wisps attack the strongest nearby zombies for 10% of their maximum health and heal you.
item.cardSummary: A kill-stack Mythic, also listed as Soulforge, that turns souls into gun damage and then bursts the strongest nearby zombies.
